module rtlpp_02583(g, b);
    parameter n=4;
    input [n-1:0] g;
    output [n-1:0] b;
    reg [n-1:0] b;
    integer i;
    always @(g) begin
        b[n-1] = g[n-1];
        for (i = n-2; i >= 0; i = i - 1) begin
            b[i] = b[i + 1] ^ g[i];
        end
    end
endmodule
